exports.build(target, root, request): Restore only verified pinned SDK closures, invoke the genuine frontend or engine, produce exactly request.artifact; retain intermediates outside build/.
exports.configure(target, root, request): Validate source/compiler/ABI combination without probing or executing a compiler. No native ROS or runtime dependency.

entry_profiles: optional implemented startup modes; command remains the compatibility default

request_fields.binding: Complete platform binding descriptor, including backend_roots and native_definitions.
request_fields.distribution: Explicit native ROS distribution or absent for wasi.
request_fields.entry: command by default; an explicitly requested freestanding startup requires an advertised adapter entry_profiles capability.
request_fields.features: Dense unique array of requested Core features.
request_fields.native_sources: SDK-relative scalar ABI glue; application records remain in the source language.
request_fields.platform: Provider id for diagnostics only; compiler actions cannot branch on vendor schemas.
request_fields.triple: Exact requested guest target; no wasm32 fallback.

restrictions: Never infer ROS/WASI permissions while configuring or building.
Never evaluate source on the build host to precompute application results.
Never substitute C for another source language.
Never accept a compiler override with an unpinned identity.
Run actions are separate and never bootstrap a source compiler.
